intents_zh: 同一 PR 只跑最新
code:
name: CI
on: [push, pull_request]

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      - uses: actions/checkout@v4
      - run: echo "only the latest commit runs"
